_comment: Copy this to dart_defines.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. Run with: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=dart_defines.json
_optional_comment: The values below are only needed if your API keys are restricted by app identity (recommended for production). Leave blank to use unrestricted development keys.
_signin_comment: Optional Google sign-in, which shows your Google Maps saved places on ranked results. Leave blank to build without it — the app works fully signed out. GOOGLE_SERVER_CLIENT_ID must be the WEB OAuth client id even on mobile: it is what makes Google return the serverAuthCode the backend exchanges for a refresh token. Android resolves its own client from the SHA-1 registered in Firebase, so it needs no entry here.
